Russia and Ukraine exchange drone and missile strikes

Russia and Ukraine have escalated their long-range attacks on each other. Russian forces launched missile strikes on the Kyiv region, killing at least 14 people and damaging warehouses, according to responders. Ukraine has also used long-range drones to strike targets inside Russia, including a strategic bomber base, and authorities reported six deaths and damaged warehouses in Russia from Ukrainian drone attacks. Ukraine's drone attacks have targeted Russian oil facilities and infrastructure over the past year.
